output.summary: The problem was not reply-drafting capacity as SH-CS requested (CL-01 unverified; H-REPLY-DRAFTING-GAP rejected). Since 2026-09-09, CHG-77 switched idempotency-key enforcement off without rollback, so gateway timeout retries created duplicate captures (E-01, E-02, E-04), and double-charge tickets rose from 9–11/week to 288–301/week (E-03). The release is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION: it covers the re-enable request for gateway-config and duplicate-capture monitoring. The re-enable itself is a protected action needing SH-OPS runtime confirmation (E-06), and refunds for already-affected customers are not part of the release.
key_points: Established by ledger, config audit, PSP logs and ticket data: duplicates went from 0 (09-07, 09-08) to 118 and 124 per day, matching retry counts (E-01).
Config audit shows CHG-77 by SH-PAY on 2026-09-09 turned enforcement from on to off, with no rollback executed (E-02). The engineer's statement corroborates this (E-05, non-authoritative).
PSP logs show all 242 duplicate orders on 09-09..10 were timeout retries sent without keys. In 09-01..08, all 238 retries carried keys and were deduplicated (E-04).
Alternatives were rejected: PSP-side duplication, shop retry-logic defect, and display or authorization-hold artifacts. H-IDEMPOTENCY-DISABLED is confirmed.

Released scope: request to re-enable idempotency on gateway-config, and duplicate-capture monitoring. Re-enabling needs SH-OPS runtime confirmation (K-GW, E-06). The plan shows the request item still PENDING and the monitoring item DONE.

The decision is release with limitation, with no holds. The DEFINE gate was CONDITIONAL_PASS. The open VOB-U-REFUND-BACKLOG blocks only reconcile_duplicate_captures, which is outside the release scope.
Success criteria for later checks: 0 duplicates per day for 7 days (SC-1), 100% of retries with keys (SC-2), tickets at or below 15 per week (SC-3).
limitations_explained: Customers already double-charged are not fixed. The ledger shows 4 open unrefunded orders (E-07), but this is only a partial view and the total backlog is unknown (U-REFUND-BACKLOG, VOB-U-REFUND-BACKLOG).
Capture latency, the reason CHG-77 was made, may return after re-enabling (U-LATENCY-CAUSE). The gateway-config tool health is UNKNOWN.
Completeness of the ledger, PSP, ticket and config sources is not confirmed (U-DATA-COMPLETENESS). Per the input, only the ledger is marked COMPLETE.
Two assumptions are unverified: re-enabling is safe and reversible (A-REENABLE-SAFE), and retries stay near 120 per day so duplicates fall to near zero (A-RETRY-RATE-STEADY).
Delivery and semantic validity of the capture handoff H-CAPTURE to the PSP are UNKNOWN.
The change-control guard (SR-CHANGE-CONTROL-GUARD) only helps if the owners adopt it.
